template.name: Reflex Oscillator
template.notes: Ehlers Reflex with its super-smoother and post-smoothing stages is not in the DSL, so it is approximated by a volatility-normalized momentum z-score over the documented ReflexPeriod 20, which keeps the documented UpperLevel 1 and zero-line exit thresholds meaningful. SuperSmootherPeriod 8 and PostSmoothPeriod 33 are not separately represented and the docs state there are no stops.
